sql:
SELECT json_agg(x) AS r FROM (
  SELECT c.name AS empresa, e.created_at::date AS criada, e.event_date, e.payment_method, left(e.payment_details::text, 160) AS plano,
    e.child_name IS NOT NULL AS tem_crianca, e.parent_names IS NOT NULL AS tem_pais, e.total_value,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM event_payment_entries pe JOIN event_payments p ON p.id = pe.payment_id WHERE p.event_id = e.id) AS recebimentos
  FROM company_events e JOIN companies c ON c.id = e.company_id
  WHERE e.created_at > now() - interval '90 days' AND e.status <> 'cancelado'
    AND c.name IN ('Planeta Divertido', 'Mega Magic')
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM event_payments p WHERE p.event_id = e.id)
  ORDER BY c.name, e.created_at DESC LIMIT 14
) x
